notes: Verifier 2026-11-15: the Scout's pages.dev address is a copy; the farm's real domain is oahumeats.com (support@oahumeats.com), and all facts were rechecked there: homepage, beef, store, Oahu Meats, Land and Livestock, beef boxes and FAQ pages. Oahu Meats is the beef brand of Griffith Livestock, raised by the Griffith family on Oahu's west side. The Land and Livestock page says the cattle are raised on Oahu pasture with rotational grazing; no page says grass only or mentions grain (the store is titled Shop All Grass-Fed Beef), so the cautious category is pastured. The store lists about 25 cuts plus eighth, quarter and half bundles (whole 440 lb bundle on the beef boxes page). Orders are placed online for collection at the ranch in Waianae, usually Fridays 4 to 6 PM; the FAQ says shipping is not offered. The ranch also runs sheep for targeted grazing.
